text.p: Tropical Cyclone Chantelle, with 75 mph winds, is in the South Indian Ocean near 9s/77e, moving west at 12 mph. This system will continue to intensify and move west southwest over open water, threatening shipping. Top winds by 48 hours could be near 115 mph.

Tropical Depression 40W will be fairly weak in the eastern Philippine Sea, only a moderate threat to shipping. This system will continue to weaken and will likely dissipate over open waters by 24-36 hours.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY STATEMENTS AT THIS TIME
